block_1_metadata.author: CreativeWorkzStudio LLC / ProfessorSeanEX
block_1_metadata.role: Universal 5-Block Protocol specification for AsciiDoc technical, architectural, and game-design documentation
invariants: Comment Syntax Purity: Multi-line Block 1..5 banners use native AsciiDoc block comments (//// ... ////); Sub-Assembly dividers use single-line comments (// --- Sub-Assembly X.Y: ... ---).
Valid Asciidoctor Header Order: BLOCK 1 ////...//// precedes line 1 (= Document Title), keeping {doctitle}, {author}, {revnumber}, and :toc: natively valid in standalone asciidoctor.
Zero Comment Leakage: All ////...//// blocks and non-fence // lines are omitted by Asciidoctor HTML/PDF and stripped cleanly by tools/src/guide.rs during Markdown compilation.

Section Depth Discipline: Standalone chapters start internal headings at == (level 1); guide.rs automatically shifts chapters +1 under Book chapters so PDF output never creates spurious chapter page breaks.

Snapshot Traceability: Embedded code listings reference verified IDs from docs/code_snapshots_manifest.json via include::../snapshots/<id>.adoc[] so both inline excerpts and Wholesale Appendix plates stay live.

recommended_asciidoc_features: [source,<lang>,linenums,start=<N>] synchronized code plates with callout lists (<1>, <2>)
**** delimited sidebars for Designer Box / Engineer Deep-Dive callout panels
[cols="...",options="header"] tables using a| AsciiDoc rich cells where lists/code appear in table cells
[qanda] definition lists for onboarding Q&A and self-audit checks
[[anchor]] explicit cross-references and ifdef::has-snapshot-appendix[] wholesale links
